steps: The Boss and the Witch form an alliance and share an unforgettable moment.
I feel dizzy... I really wanna throw up.
Wow, I had no idea you could fly that fast...
It's just part of the job when you're a witch!
Even though she threw out some cool lines at those creeping stalkers, Mistique surprisingly—and pretty decisively—made a run for it!
Well, at least she had the decency to grab me before taking off.
Her broom really is fast... But if there's ever a next time...
I hope it'll at least be a nice, smooth ride, not a frantic escape like this.
But seriously, Boss, I had no idea you were this valuable.
Looks like this client wants more than just photos of you.
Ugh, this is a total mid-commission hijack attempt! Ever heard of professional ethics?!
So even a mischievous witch like her has moments when she can't keep her cool.
We might be safe for now, but who knows when the bad guys will show up again?
… They specifically asked for her, huh?==W== … I see.
The answer's right there in the question. If I don't clear it up now and Mistique gets the wrong idea, that'll create problems.
Tch... And here I was hoping to check out a few more spots with you.
Mistique, calm down, listen to me—
Don't you think what happened was really strange?
Oh? Has my brilliant Boss figured something out?
… Ah, hearing the Boss call me by name—what a treat!
I'm used to this kind of teasing from her, so I just keep explaining my theory.
Were those people really after me?
Mistique, have you been getting tailed more than usual lately?
So you're saying... You aren't the one being followed, it's me they are after?
When you think you're the hunter, you might actually be the prey.
Oh my gosh, are you actually worried about me?!
N-no, of course not. Just a logical deduction, that's all.
Mistique, you're always on the move, hard to track down. Whoever's after you probably noticed how interested you've been in me lately.
So they figured if they used me as bait... You'd show up on the streets without a second thought.
I see... They got me there.
When you're on your own, no one can catch you, because you're always zipping around on your broom.
But if you need to sneak photos of me, you start to move slower and become way easier to spot.
You must have some idea, Mistique. Who would want to catch you?
She answers me with a teasing grin, skipping in circles with her hands tucked behind her back.
Trying to dodge my question again, huh?
As you know, I'm a witch, and a great one at that.
Yes, we all know that. Please go on.
I've pissed a lot of people off with my reports.
Scarlet Sight Media's already stopped giving me assignments a while ago, but I'm still out there every day, chasing stories on my own.
There are just way too many people who want me to stop digging.
I didn't figure anyone in Nova could attract even more attention than Boss Accord.
One of the perks of being a witch, I guess.
If what you're saying is true, and all this trouble started because someone's trying to take me down...
Then maybe I should stop flying by to hang out with you.
… Because I still want to be that witch who chases the truth.
But if being around you puts you in danger... Then I really would be just a witch who brings bad luck...
This isn't something to joke about, so I cut her off mid-sentence.
I don't want her to get the wrong idea.
Didn't I just say? You are the special kind of witch...
A fearsome witch whose very existence alone draws the attention of enemies, just like Boss Accord!
The Boss who wants to turn the world upside down, and the Witch who's managed to tick the whole world off. Sounds like a power duo to me!
Besides, I'm the Boss! Protecting a witch is easy peasy!
Heh,==W== I'm gonna remember what you just said!
No, no, very much befitting your station, Boss!
The Witch and the Boss, making a pact! Ah, what a memorable moment...
Can I take a photo to capture the moment?
I'm gonna hold you to that.
Hey, Boss? ==W==How are you feeling right now?==W==
I-I can't move! What did you do!?
Relax. ==W==It's just little spell that gives me control of your body. ==W====W==It's your fault, you know. ==W====W==Sneaking into my heart like that.
Ehehe...==W== After all, ==W====W==if we're taking a photo, ==W==it has to be a good one. ★==W==
You know, ==W==the Boss mustn't break promises. ==W====W==You agreed to the photo shoot, remember? ==W====W==Now come on, smile! ♪
Hm? ==W==The framing isn't bad ...==W== but that face. Hmm...
Hah-ha. ★ ==W==Fair point. ==W==But if a photo like this were to get out, ==W====W==I wonder what people would say?==W==
Unless ...==W== you don't actually mind getting caught up in scandal with me? ==W====W==Ehehe. Come on, let's have the truth!==W==
Aww, playing it cool?==W== You're so adorable. ♪ ==W==Then how about this?
If this photo of your pathetic self made its way into the world, ==W====W==what would happen to your company's reputation?
That's not teasing anymore, that's blackmail!
Yes, ==W==that's it! ==W==That's EXACTLY the face I wanted to see, Boss! ==W==Ehehe! ==W==Now hold still... ♪
I'm not sure if Mistique let go or if I just pulled too hard—either way, I managed to break free.
What kind of pictures did you take!
Perfect! I'll title this one: The Boss's Soft and Squishy Moment!
Oh well... What am I gonna do with you...
Hehe, thanks a ton! A witch never forgets a favor!
This exclusive report will be my gift to you, Boss!
… Yeah, I can't say I am looking forward to it.
A pretty ordinary day, with bustling streets full of people.
The Witch and the Boss, our story has just begun.
Hehe, this photo of us together...
